entities.summary: Habsburg, a notable figure in the history of Croatia, associated with Ottoman Frontier and Military Border (1493–1593). Preceded by Croatian Kingdom and Battle of Krbava Field — devastating Croatian defeat by Ottomans. Their legacy influenced Croatian Parliament elects Ferdinand Habsburg as king after Mohács and Military Frontier (Vojna Krajina).
